blocks.text: TO BE THE GLOBAL MARKET LEADER IN SUPPLY OF TITANIUM AND OTHER COMPLEMENTARY SPECIALTY METALS AND SERVICES BY EMPLOYING THE BEST PEOPLE AND PARTNERING WITH HIGHLY QUALIFIED VENDORS AND CUSTOMERS WHO MOST CLOSELY ALIGN WITH OUR COMPANY COMMITMENTS.

TO OUR COWORKERS we will act fairly, with dignity, respect, and accountability while supporting each other through positive cooperation and communication in order to enable a safe, healthy, and efficient work culture.
TO OUR CUSTOMERS we will be attentive and proactive, and strive to maximize the value and quality of our supply solutions to meet or exceed expectations.

TO OUR SUPPLIERS we will emphasize fair competition and maximize participation with innovative, ethical suppliers who consistently provide industry leading quality, competitive pricing, and on-time delivery performance.
TO OUR STAKEHOLDERS we will relentlessly pursue our growth and earnings objectives while always keeping the highest ethical standards at the forefront of our activities.
TO OUR COMMUNITIES we will act as responsible and environmentally conscious corporate citizens and offer enthusiastic support and participation.

TO OUR EMPLOYEES we will provide the tools, training, and environment to enable the highest performance levels, consistently give clear direction and feedback, and recognize and reward outstanding achievement.
